title: Chhattisgarh Ayushman Card health assurance Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: State health assurance access route for eligible Chhattisgarh beneficiaries under the PM-JAY/state integrated programme.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows current Chhattisgarh beneficiary identification and scheme rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Chhattisgarh Ayushman Card health assurance.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
